text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: The showdown of the Big Three... what a shocking turn of events...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"No, but still...!
That was seriously intense!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: I'm so glad I came today! Now I'm even more excited for the next one!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"...I couldn't catch them. Not Vodka,
not Scarlet... and not Chan either."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: (The cloud of dust, the roar, the sheer heat radiating from both of them...! But I won't back down, the winner will be—)

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
It's burned right into my brain.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A thunderous round of applause enveloped Aston Machan as she headed toward the tunnel.
As if drawn by it, she looked up at the stands.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Chan, that was so close!
But you were amazing!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I never thought I'd get to see a Big Three showdown again!
Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Any place where I stand alongside those two
always becomes so vibrant.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Mar-chan is blessed with friends...
and with rivals."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Until next time, somewhere out there. Without fail.
